name: Morishita Urumi
source:
Grade: Elementary school 3rd grader.
Room: Tsubomi Dorm, Room 202.
Characteristics: The youngest in the dormitory, Urumi is tiny and cute. Although she immediately starts crying intensely if approached. She cannot swim.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
